notes.title: Update Notes for 9-21-2025
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 8 new highly technical bonus levels.
[*] Every Jungnode (with one exception which I'm saving for a later update) now unlocks a gameplay or utility feature.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where jumper hosts sometimes lost friction.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 4-19-25
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned end of tutorial for jumper hosts in order to smooth out difficulty curve
[*] Rearranged entrance to the advanced ejection mechanics tutorial so that text is displayed properly
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-23-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 8 new TQE questions. They can be found at the ends of parts 1, 2, 4, and 6.
[*] Added new Advanced Ejection Mechanics tutorial teaching about ejection momentum, momentum boosts, and increased ejection inheritance. These mechanics have always been in the game, but previously were not explained anywhere. The tutorial can be accessed from the Link between Gamma's subsystem and Delta's subsystem after completing the main story.
[*] Added new "Disregard Timers" assist feature which freezes all timers.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The menu options on the title screen now loop.
[*] You can now exit the pause menu by pressing the back button (Default: B on an Xbox controller or Backspace on a keyboard).
[*] Increased momentum boost effect for track hosts. 
[*] Minor optimization of bloom effect during warp transitions. I will do further optimization when I have the time.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-17-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new question to TQE Part 7. A new TQE Part 8 is in the works, but one question fit Part 7 better so I'm releasing it now!
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added conduits to the Jungnode levels so that you can save your progress and no longer need to complete the entire level in a single sitting.
[*] Achievements that you earned in the Demo version should now automatically transfer to the main game.
[*] Menu transparency now applies to Gate labels.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where chains between linked hosts were sometimes drawn twice.
[*] Fixed issue where TQE goal nodes would sometimes become set as the active checkpoint.
[*] Fixed issue where jumper hosts jumping on top of each other while both moving on autopilot would sometimes behave unexpectedly.
[*] Made minor performance improvements to platforming hosts.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-13-25
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made menu and popup textboxes partially transparent. Menu/popup transparency can be adjusted in the pause menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that sometimes caused crashes when using jumper and slide hosts for keyboard/mouse users.
[*] Fixed bug that sometimes caused popup textboxes to disappear instead of leaving the screen smoothly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-12-25
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added haptic feedback (vibration) for gamepads. Vibration can be toggled off in the pause menu.
[*] Added "Preferences" tab in the pause menu. More options will be added to this tab later.
[*] Added chromatic aberration effect on death. This new effect can be toggled off in the pause menu.
[*] Added sound effect for when a slide host initiates a new slide.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where closing the pause menu while simultaneously holding left on an audio slider could cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed bug where listener orientation and position were sometimes behaving in unintended ways, causing certain sound effects to be either louder than intended, or audible from further away than intended.
[*] Fixed several tiling errors.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the final gambit in Delta's subsystem in order to smooth out difficulty curve.
[*] Delta's messengers can now disarm active ports.
[*] Changed TQE1C to make it mechanically easier.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-11-25 (Part 2)
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where resetting a level while a Core was reactivating and then leaving the level before the data stream reached the end Gate caused further progress to become impossible.
[*] Fixed issue where an active slide host would sometimes display the player sprite or autopilot indicator as an arrow in situations where it should display a dot.
[*] The welcome screen now only appears when the game is first started, and not when you use the "Exit to Main Menu" feature in the pause menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-11-25
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The input system has been completely overhauled in order to improve functionality and accommodate a wider range of gamepads. The game should now automatically switch to input settings appropriate for the device you are using. Controls can still be rebound in the pause menu, as before. This should also fix a number of issues where control instructions sometimes did not match the buttons for the gamepad being used. The new input system manages saving and loading control schemes differently, so if you had a custrom control scheme set up, unfortunately you will need to set it up again.
[*] Added shortcuts to Jungnode levels at the start of each subsystem. The shortcut becomes available as soon as you access the Jungnode level for the first time.
[*] The start of Beta's Jungnode level has been redesigned in order to better teach a tricky autopilot mechanic.
[*] Several tiling errors were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-7-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new sound effect for checkpoint activation.
[*] Added new scanline visual effect. This can be toggled off or on in the pause menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reactivating the Core at the end of a subsystem now clears any corrupted conduits that you missed while traversing the level. This allows for fun skips in some levels!
[*] Data fragments may now be collected at any conduit or checkpoint, rather than only at checkpoints.
[*] Checkpoints are now activated when they are touched, regardless of whether you eject into them.
[*] One seeker was removed from Gamma's subsystem to help smooth out the difficulty curve.
[*] The first "pit" puzzle in Alpha's subsystem was made a bit easier by adjusting red barrier geometry. Also, the segment with chains of red data orbs has been made less precise.
[*] Slightly increased the latch radius for jumper and wallclimber hosts. This should make ejections to these hosts a bit more forgiving.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed accidental invisible red barrier in certain TQE Part 2 challenges.
[*] Fixed issue where hint popups would sometimes use the wrong font size.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-4-25
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added bloom effect to start-of-game warp.
[*] Fixed a significant number of tiling issues throughout the game.
[*] Reduced brightness of jumper hosts, solid track hosts, and slide hosts in order to improve visual clarity, especially when bloom is active.
[*] Added new hint in Epsilon's subsystem.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-2-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new twist and increased bloom effect to warp animation. These effects can be toggled off in the pause menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted bloom effect to improve visual clarity. Bloom can still be toggled off or adjusted in the pause menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3-1-25
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Bloom effect. This can be toggled on or off and adjusted in the pause menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where music volume would change suddenly when starting to warp while the "reactivate Core" sound effect was playing.
[*] Fixed several tiling issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 2-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new and improved sound effects for data fragment collection, host system repair, and Core reactivation.
[*] Redesigned Alpha's subsystem to smooth out difficulty curve and improve tutorial.
[*] The pause menu can now be navigated using the d-pad for gamepad users.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed audio files that are no longer used in the game, dramatically reducing overall file size.
[*] Fixed a number of tiling issues throughout the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 2-14-25
notes.content: This patch fixes hundreds of tiling errors throughout the game, and slightly reduces the volume of the title-screen music.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2-9-25
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added rebindable control option for toggling projectile mode without going through the pause menu.
[*] Added new musical composition for the final security enforcer and power conduit.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed tiling issues throughout the game. Some still remain.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The repair core now forms a teardrop shape while ejected and moving.
[*] Redesigned final power conduit.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 2-2-25
notes.content:
Greetings, Technicians!

I haven't had much time this past month to do gamedev stuff due work obligations, but hope to start creating new puzzles again soon.

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new musical composition for the Jungnode levels.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the brightness of some backgrounds in order to reduce visual clutter.
[*] Changed the design of the white tileset in order to reduce visual clutter.
[/list]
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a large number of tiling issues. Many still remain, and I will continue working on fixing them!
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1-10-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented dynamic lighting system, which can be toggled on or off in the options menu under "Video".
[*] Ambient particles have been re-implemented, and can be toggled on or off in the options menu under "Video".
[*] Updated all tile-sets to a new, hopefully improved style.
[*] New and improved textboxes and options menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some sprites and/or text in the credits would sometimes not be displayed.
[*] Fixed issue where a reminder message giving instructions on how to proceed would sometimes fail to be displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1-7-25
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added portals! They appear in the access port (tutorial area) as well as several of the TQE (technician qualification exam) puzzles.
[*] Added two additional TQE parts, and added more questions to existing TQE parts.
[*] You can now see which TQE questions you have already solved at the the entrance gate to each part, and can also choose which question to warp to.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where waiting longer than a minute between collecting credit tokens during the end credits caused the game to crash.
[*] Fixed issue where the player sprite would sometimes be the wrong color when ejecting into hosts on autopilot.
[*] Removed the ambient particle system, which was causing significant performance issues even when toggled off. These will be added back in if I can find a way to make them perform better.
[*] Fixed issue where hint prompts sometimes intersected with popup dialogue.
[*] Increased efficiency of collision detection with red walls.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Using experimental ejection mechanics is now not allowed within TQE questions.
[*] Fractions of a second within time and target trials are now displayed in centiseconds (1/100 of a second)  rather than frames (1/60 of a second).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1-1-25 (Part 2)
notes.content:
This update contains several optimization changes that should significantly improve performance.

[b]Optimization Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified texture groups to reduce unnecessary texture swaps.
[*] Made several changes to particle effects to improve performance.
[*] Changed how certain lines are drawn to reduce texture swaps.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1-1-25
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

This update contains quite a bit of new content along with several bug fixes.

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Technician Qualification Exam, which you can access below Epsilon's subsystem in the Link. The exam consists of over 50 new puzzles/challenges, and more are on the way!
[*] Added two new original music pieces to the soundtrack.
[*] Added time and target trials for several levels which previously did not have them. They unlock after completing the main story.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where two hosts pushing each other in opposite directions would sometimes result in unexpected behavior.
[*] Fixed issue where momentum would sometimes be inherited on ejection from stationary hosts.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 12-25-24
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added quick level reset feature (useful for resetting time and target trials without navigating a menu)
[*] Added goal times and ranks for every time trial. Ranks for target trials will be included in a future update.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where entering certain rooms after completing the game caused a crash.
[*] Fixed several crashes that could occur in rare cases involving forced warps.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 12-21-24
notes.content:
Greetings, valued Technicians!

I'll be posting updates as frequently as I am able with both bug fixes, improvements, and new content (including new levels, hosts, and puzzles). Please do let me know if you have any suggestions, bug reports, or ideas for new mechanics! My plan is to continue improving and adding to Alpha and Iota for as long as anyone (even a small community) wants to keep playing it.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now transit the network stream (yellow lasers) in both directions. The direction of transit can be controlled either with the left control stick of a controller or the mouse cursor.
[*] Added "Half Speed" option in the Assist Features menu.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The player's repair core now remains green while ejected, but turns yellow when in a host on autopilot. I believe this makes it a bit easier to keep track of where you are, and also improves the aesthetic of autopilot.
[*] The trail left behind the player upon ejection is now more focused. I think it looks a bit better this way.
[*] Slightly redesigned the end of Beta's subsystem.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where certain forced warps could cause the game to crash if they happened just as you warped yourself to a new area.
[/list]
